Add a Salary Structure Type

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn how to add a structure type, which sets the pay basis and default schedule shared by a family of salary structures.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Structure Types

Click Structure Types.

4. New

Click New to create a record.

5. Name

Type the name, then press Tab.

6. Save

Click the save icon to keep the record.

7. Saved

The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.
